shared_file_insertions.inserted_text: **更强的结构唯一性 / Stronger structural uniqueness, 8 October 2026.** [新研究](_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-COMPOSITION-INTEGRATION.md)新增 **36项 Lean 定理／110项含继承审计**：固定序列拼接与全部前后接续问题后，共同最小结构一般存在；任意准确表述都保留其因子，准确约简表述之间保持组合与单位元的同构成立。三类预算及当前／单侧问题不足的反例已查。 / This integrates the established syntactic-congruence route. Audits: 77 empty, 30 propext only, 3 propext plus Quot.sound. Next justify/recover boundary-sensitive composition from joint-realization targets; universal explanatory priority and ontology remain open.

**组合结构唯一性 / Uniqueness of composition structure, 8 October 2026.** [新连接](unified-2026-10-05/EXPLANATORY-NECESSITY.md#23-从相同回答到可替换的片段)以36项新 Lean 定理证明可替换关系、诱导组合、一般最小表述存在、所有准确表述的共同因子与约简后的同构；三类预算的区别与组合表被目标确定。 / Fixed word composition and all contextual answers are explicit inputs. The known syntactic-congruence precedent and standard logical dependencies are disclosed; no unique ontology or normative warrant is inferred. Next examine boundary-sensitive partial joining.

**Contextual substitution → common factor → structural uniqueness, 8 October 2026.** [The composition study](../../../_process/research/2026-10-05-generative-foundation-review/root-foundation/EXPLANATORY-COMPOSITION-INTEGRATION.md) adds 36 checked theorems / 110 audits: 77 empty, 30 propext only, 3 also Quot.sound. C30.claim_en: Target-relevant relations connect variation, evidence acquisition and reuse. Exact reduced presentations uniquely match for fixed questions, while same-content global coverage and structural explanations remain viable; recoverability alone does not select explanatory priority.

Minimality and questions are explicit; color obstruction does not determine all coverage. Next test preserved composition; universal uniqueness and normative warrant remain open.

F22.title_zh: 关系恢复、证据再用与相对唯一性

F22.claim_zh: 继承必要内容、变化与校准证明；新增准确约简表述的唯一对应、整体覆盖与局部放置等价、去角棋盘结构障碍和问题范围反例。

F22.scope_zh: 最新17项结构＋15项唯一性定理，连同42项继承审计共74项；核心相对唯一性为空依赖，12项结构相关声明使用标准propext，无自定公理。表述对应不等于生成操作同构，形式验证不证明唯一基础。

Core relative uniqueness has empty dependencies; 12 structural declarations use standard propext, with no custom axioms. Presentation matching is not generative-operation isomorphism or unique grounding.

C30.claim_en: Fixed concatenation and all two-sided contextual questions force a common minimal composition structure. Every exact presentation retains its factor; reduced exact presentations are isomorphic with composition and unit preserved. Global accounts remain eligible; ontological or explanatory priority is not selected.
